	id = swe_tree
	country = { factor = 0 modifier = { add = 10 tag = SWE } }
	focus = {
		id = SWE_root
		cost = 10
		available = { has_war = no }
	}
	focus = {
		id = SWE_left
		prerequisite = { focus = SWE_root }
		mutually_exclusive = { focus = SWE_right }
		bypass = { has_country_flag = swe_skip }
		cost = 5
	}
	focus = {
		id = SWE_right
		prerequisite = { focus = SWE_root }
		mutually_exclusive = { focus = SWE_left }
	}
	focus = {
		id = SWE_end
		prerequisite = { focus = SWE_left focus = SWE_right }
		prerequisite = { focus = SWE_root }
	}
}
